title: Quasi-isomorphism of a normalized dual Koszul comparison
statement: For a commutative ring A, ideal I, and finite Koszul-regular sequence f indexed by Fin r generating I [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence], every A-linear cochain map from the signed dual Koszul complex [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex] to wedge^r_(A/I) Hom_(A/I)(I/I^2,A/I) concentrated in degree r that satisfies [def-sc-koszul-conormal-comparison] induces isomorphisms on cohomology in every degree.

proof.text: Complementary basis wedges identify Hom_A(wedge^n E,A) with wedge^(r-n) E for n <= r; the terms vanish for n > r. Evaluate contraction on basis wedges to identify the signed dual differential with the reversed Koszul differential up to degree signs; recursively rescale by units +1 or -1. Koszul-regularity then gives vanishing cohomology outside r.

The top dual term is rank one on evaluation at e_top. The incoming image is exactly I times this generator, since the complementary coordinate functionals extract the coefficients +f_i or -f_i of d_r(e_top). Thus the top cokernel is A/I. For r=0 the incoming image is zero and I=0.

The conormal basis makes the normal determinant rank one on the ordered dual wedge. Test the given normalization on the standard basis of E: its top component is quotient evaluation times the unit (-1)^(r*(r-1)/2). It induces an isomorphism on top cohomology, while every other homology map is between zero objects. Hence the given map is a quasi-isomorphism.

theorem koszul_conormal_comparison_is_quasiIso
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I)
    (φ : koszulDualComplex A r f ⟶
      (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat A) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) r).obj
        (koszulNormalDeterminant A I r))
    (hφ : IsKoszulConormalComparison A I r f hf φ) : QuasiIso φ
